messages:
Samir: Quick sync to capture postmortem follow-ups for the KV-cache OOM. We need owners, backups, deadlines, and explicit abort criteria for the soft-limit + reclaim changes.
Anya: Ill own profiling & RCA verification. Plan: capture two snapshots per shard (low/high churn), diff, produce flamegraphs, and upload artifacts. ETA: Fri EOD.
Javier: I'll own config changes and the staged rollout. Proposal: per-shard soft_limit_ratio=0.72, eviction_policy=lru_aggressive, disable per-model warmers for churny models. Rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m windows. Abort if p95 latency increases >20ms or evictions/sec >2x baseline.
Priya: Telemetry + alerts. I'll add fragmentation_ratio (per-shard) and kv_residency_bytes (per-model). Regression alert: fragmentation delta > 12% for 10m. I'll also add dashboard cells and a Grafana playbook snapshot. ETA: Thu EOD.
Samir: Backups: Kai backs Anya for infra; Priya backs Javier on rollback automation. Add these to the postmortem checklist.
Anya: Short profiling steps:
```
kv_snapshot --shard=$S --out=/tmp/kv-$S.$TS.snap
kv_diff /tmp/kv-*.snap > /tmp/diff.$TS.txt
flamegraph-gen /tmp/kv-*.snap > /artifacts/flame.$TS.svg
```
Artifacts -> s3://redwood-oom/postmortem-2222222222/.
Javier: Config snippet I'll test:
```
shard_defaults:
  soft_limit_ratio: 0.72
  eviction_policy: lru_aggressive
```
Per-model override: prefix_warmer.enabled=false for affected models.
Priya: Runbook steps (short): trigger -> fragmentation_ratio >12% OR evictions/sec >150 for 10m; action -> disable warmers for top 3 models, throttle heavy writers (10% steps), run emergency slab_compact if needed (two approvers), escalate after 30m.
Samir: Who owns the emergency reclaim job and the toggle? We need a safe procedure.
Anya: I can coordinate with infra to add the toggle; Kai will own the compact job. I'll be primary for profiling and emergency decisions.
Javier: I'll add rollback automation to the canary pipeline so the job reverts config and notifies oncall if abort criteria hit. PR inbound AM.
Priya: I'll add synthetic churn tests in staging to validate soft_limit+LRU under write-heavy patterns; run nightly for a week pre-rollout.
eng-oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: "KV OOM follow-up check-in" 2026-03-30 10:00 UTC  attendees: eng-runtime.
Samir: Deadlines recap: profiling (Anya) by 2026-03-27 EOD; canary config & automation (Javier) 2026-03-25 AM; alerts/dashboard (Priya) 2026-03-26 EOD; emergency reclaim job (Kai) 48h. Tag me for blockers. :thumbsup:
